Website policies

Hōlus Nutrition Counselling

Operated by Juliana dos Santos in Ontario, Canada.

1. Privacy Policy

I take your privacy seriously. I collect only the information I need to provide Nutrition Counselling, and I am the person responsible for protecting it.

What I collect

  • Your name, email, phone number and appointment details.
  • The enquiry type and general message you submit through the website contact form.
  • Health, nutrition, food and lifestyle information you choose to share.
  • Your goals and what we talk about in sessions.
  • Payment details, which are handled by my payment provider. I do not see or keep your full card number.

How I use it

To provide your sessions, keep your client record, book appointments, send you your plans and summaries, take payment, issue receipts and meet my legal obligations. I do not use your information for anything else without asking you first, and I never sell it.

Where it is kept

Your client record is kept in Jane, a secure practice-management platform. I also use email to arrange appointments, so please keep health details out of email when you can and share them in Jane or in session instead.

If the guided website contact form is available, it is for general enquiries only. Formspree processes the name, email, enquiry type and message you submit so it can deliver the enquiry to me and filter spam. Formspree may process and temporarily store submissions in the United States. Please do not use the form for symptoms, diagnoses, medications, test results, documents or other personal health information.

I may use writing tools, including AI tools, to help draft documents like session summaries. I remove your name and anything that could identify you before I do, and nothing that identifies you is saved in those tools.

Some of the companies I use may store information outside Canada, where it may be subject to the laws of that country.

Who I share it with

I only share your information with the companies that help me run my practice (such as Jane and my payment and email providers), and only what they need. I will not share it with anyone else, including your doctor or another provider, without your written consent, unless the law requires it.

How long I keep it

I keep client records for 10 years after our last session, then delete them securely.

Your rights

You can ask to see your record or to correct anything that is wrong. Email me and I will respond within 30 days. You can also withdraw your consent at any time, subject to legal limits; I will explain what that means for our work together.

If something goes wrong

If your information is lost or seen by someone who should not see it, and this could cause you significant harm, I will tell you and report it to the privacy commissioner as the law requires.

This website

This website does not use advertising cookies or behavioural tracking. When the guided general-enquiry form is enabled, it is processed by Formspree. Like most websites, the hosting, form-processing and font services may log basic technical details such as your IP address for delivery, security and abuse prevention.

Questions or concerns

Contact me at hello@holus.ca. If you are not satisfied with my answer, you can contact the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada or the Information and Privacy Commissioner of Ontario.

2. Scope of Practice

I provide one-on-one Nutrition Counselling: nutrition education, meal planning, habit coaching and general guidance based on Health Canada and current research.

I am a Nutritionist and a Registered Social Service Worker. I am not a Registered Dietitian or a physician.

What I do not do

Nutrition Counselling does not replace care from your physician or other healthcare providers. I do not diagnose or treat any condition, provide medical nutrition therapy, prescribe or change medications, or interpret medical tests.

If something comes up that is outside my scope, I will suggest you speak with the right provider. With your written consent, I can send them a short letter.

3. Terms and Conditions

By booking a session, you agree to the following.

Sessions

My sessions are nutrition education and counselling based on what you share with me and current evidence. Results vary, and I cannot guarantee specific outcomes.

Your part

Please share accurate information, tell me about any changes in your health or medications, come to your appointments, and keep seeing your doctor and other providers as needed.

Fees and payment

Session lengths and fees are on the Services page. I confirm the fee and how to pay before your appointment, and you receive a receipt after each session.

Cancellations and rescheduling

Please give at least 24 hours' notice to cancel or reschedule.

Late cancellations and missed appointments may be charged a fee, which I confirm when you book. I make exceptions for emergencies.

Website and resources

Articles and downloads on this website are general information, not personal advice.

The content and materials I create belong to Hōlus Nutrition Counselling. Please do not copy or share them commercially without my permission.

Applicable law

These terms are governed by the laws of Ontario and Canada.
